question: Earliest model run served by the Open-Meteo Single Runs API (snow_depth, run-resolved) - can controlled-lead grading reach past winters?
method: HTTP probes at Vail grid cell (39.6403,-106.3742 area), hourly snow_depth, run=<date>T00:00, forecast_days=1-2, timezone=UTC. ECMWF bisected between 2026-01-15 (HTTP 400) and 2026-04-05 (OK); other models spot-checked.
finding: Single Runs API serves runs from 2026-04-02 onward for ALL probed models including ecmwf_ifs025. The docs statement 'ECMWF IFS HRES runs archived from 2024-03' does NOT hold on this endpoint (every 2024-03..2026-01 probe returned HTTP 400 'model run is not available').
consequence: Controlled lead-N snow-depth grading cannot reach the 2024-25 or 2025-26 winters; the storm-day sample grows only from new accumulation going forward. The only historical route is the Historical Forecast API (mixed/unknown lead provenance), which violates the controlled-lead measurement contract.
